Hammersmith & City.reason: Hammersmith and City Line: Severe delays due to an earlier points failure at Tower Hill. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses, Mildmay line, DLR, Elizabeth line, C2C and Southwestern Railway.

Mildmay.reason: Mildmay Line: No service between Willesden Junction and Shepherd's Bush while we fix a track fault at Shepherd's Bush. NO SERVICE between Stratford and Gospel Oak and SEVERE DELAYS between Gospel Oak and Richmond due to emergency engineering work to fix overhead power lines. London Underground are accepting tickets via any reasonable route. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Tram.reason: LONDON TRAMS: From Thursday 6 until Sunday 23 August, no service between Reeves Corner and East Croydon.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.
